notes: Division by exactly zero: raise (ZeroDivisionError) vs return a sentinel (0.0, nan, +-inf, or +-float max).
Sign of the result when b == 0: sign-aware (+inf / -inf / -max) vs constant sentinel regardless of sign of a.
Negative zero denominator (-0.0): IEEE candidate flips the sign of the result; others ignore it.
0/0 specifically: nan vs 0.0 vs raise (indeterminate form treated differently from x/0).
Near-zero denominators: only the epsilon candidate treats |b| < 1e-9 as zero, giving 0.0 instead of a huge quotient.
Non-finite inputs (nan/inf): the strict-validation candidate raises ValueError; all others propagate per float arithmetic.
'Safe' result finiteness: saturating candidate never returns inf/nan, whereas the IEEE and nan candidates do.
